s1.quote: With excellent visibility of 23 meters and a maximum depth of 31 meters, this advanced-level dive site near Villingili, Gaafu Alif, 16030, Maldives

s2.quote: Villingili Kandu - This channel south of the Island Villingili offers with an incoming current a spectacular dive. Large quantities of grey reef sharks can be observed patrolling back and forth in front of the channel. … the middle of the roughly 200m wide channel bottom at 30+ meters.

highlights.text: Large numbers of grey reef sharks in the channel

summary.text: A channel (kandu) south of Villingili island in the Maldives, best on an incoming current when grey reef sharks patrol the mouth in numbers. The channel floor is at about 30 m and divers are generally expected to be advanced.
